name: @pipeworx/mcp-climate

tools.name: get_climate_projection
tools.description: Get historical and future temperature and precipitation projections for a location (1950–2050). Returns daily forecasts with temperature, precipitation, and weather conditions.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (must be between 1950 and 2050).

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (must be between 1950 and 2050).

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Compare temperature projections across climate models for the same location and date range. Returns side-by-side daily mean temperatures to assess model agreement and uncertainty.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (must be between 1950 and 2050).

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (must be between 1950 and 2050).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-climate forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the climate pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
